title: 第五章 赵老爷发来邀约第六章 夺船之恨
content_zh:
望着在门口晃荡的两道身影，梁渠眉头一皱。
这两宾州谁啊？大半夜不睡觉，搁我家门口晃。
门口，一中年人与一身形精瘦的小厮前后站立，刚刚问话的便是那皮肤偏白的中年人，此人衣服干净整洁，怎么看都不像个平头百姓。
望着明显有点来头的中年人，梁渠在脑海中快速搜索。
另一边的郑向见梁渠不说话，还以为对方仍在纠结，他挥挥手，一旁的小厮立即举起一麻袋，撑开袋口。
郑向卷起袖子，伸手探入其中，借着月光，梁渠看到那人居然抓出一大把白灿灿的精米！
梁渠咽了口唾沫，刚来时的胃痛，着实给他留下了些许心理阴影。
郑向将手中的大米缓缓倾倒在布袋中：“怎样，只要认了我们赵老爷当义父，这斗精米就是你的，而且往后吃的也都是这样的好，米！”
义父！
听到这个词，梁渠大脑似乎打开了某个开关，不过不是“公若不弃，布愿拜为义父”
的开关，而是整件事的前因后果。
面前的中年男子，就是隔壁镇那位有寒潭的赵老爷府上的管家之一郑向！
对方来此的目的很简单，买奴才！
都到门口了，那个被买的奴才是谁不言而喻。
至于为什么买奴才要说成是认义父，只因大顺开国皇帝规定一般人禁养私奴，所以许多老财都是以收干女儿干儿子的形式收养奴仆的，只要有公证人证明就行，和后世有异曲同工之妙。
按理说，原身生活如此困顿，卖身倒也不失为一条活路，这又是管家又是精粮，实在是给足了面子。
可问题的关键就在这，谁家招奴才这么上心？
那赵老爷，据传好男色！
梁渠刚来时就发现，自己穿过来的少年不仅名字一样，长相也神似，堪称平行时空的自己，即使常年跟随父亲出船打鱼，皮肤黑糙了些，可五官极佳，模样周正，养一养，绝对不差。
两相结合，所谓的“据传”

，多半是真的。
想到这，梁渠打了个寒颤，浑身嫌恶。
“考虑得如何？”
郑向又问一遍。
上次登门，被推脱要考虑考虑，但现在，他有十足把握，对方再不接受自己的条件，怕是近几天就要饿死在家中！
郑向甚至连牙行的人都叫过来了，也是做个担保，免得梁渠这边刚把自己卖了，转头就反悔到官府去告官，说赵家逼良为奴。
倒不是赵家怕被告，谁会喜欢惹麻烦？擦屁股还要费几张纸呢。
一旁的牙行小厮也帮腔：“是啊是啊，小郎君，能去赵府，那是咱们普通人几辈子都修不来的福气啊，用得着像现在这样风里来雨里去，一年还吃不上几口粮？”
‘你奶奶滴，这福气谁爱享谁享，也不怕拉屎擦不干净腚。
梁渠暗骂一句，面上不动声色地婉拒，赵家家大业大，实在不是他现在能开罪的：“实在抱歉，郑管家，小的命薄，享不来那滔天福气，让您白来一趟过意不去，不如就将这条黄鱼带回去，当作我的赔礼吧。”
牙行小厮目瞪口呆。
郑向脸色一变，完全没料到梁渠会拒绝，他猛靠上来，逼得梁渠后退两步，可距离还是拉近不少，一下子让他察觉到异常。
这梁渠气色怎如此之好？丝毫不像饿过几天的模样！
还有这黄鱼哪来的，他捕的？
郑向心思百转，不理解为什么一个无依无靠的少年，会在这短短几天时来运转？
梁渠吓了一跳，正当他还想说些什么拯救自己的小命时，郑向反倒先平静下来：“无事，本就是一桩你情我愿的买卖，赔礼道歉倒也不必，能捕到黄鱼本就不易，小郎君就留着吧，天色已晚，我就不多留了，告辞！”
说话间，郑向已带着牙行小厮离开，只留下门口处拎着黄鱼的梁渠。
content_en:
Looking at the two figures wandering at the door, Liang Qu frowned.
Who are these two Pennsylvanians? He stayed up most of the night and hung out in front of my house.
At the door, a middle-aged man and a lean young man were standing in front of and behind each other. The one who had just asked the question was the middle-aged man with fair skin. This man's clothes were clean and tidy, and he did not look like an ordinary person.
Looking at the middle-aged man who obviously had some background, Liang Qu searched quickly in his mind.
Zheng Xiang on the other side saw that Liang Qu was silent and thought the other party was still struggling. He waved his hand, and the boy beside him immediately raised a sack and opened the mouth of the sack.
Zheng Xiang rolled up his sleeves and reached into it. Under the moonlight, Liang Qu saw that the man actually grabbed a large handful of white polished rice!
Liang Qu swallowed. The stomach pain he felt when he first arrived really left a little psychological shadow on him.
Zheng Xiang slowly poured the rice in his hand into the bag: "What, as long as you recognize our Mr. Zhao as your adoptive father, this bushel of polished rice will be yours, and the rice you eat from now on will be as good as this!"
Foster father!
Hearing this word, Liang Qu's brain seemed to turn on a certain switch, but it wasn't "If you don't abandon me, I will be your adoptive father."
switch, but the cause and effect of the whole thing.
The middle-aged man in front of him is Zheng Xiang, one of the butlers of Mr. Zhao's house in Hantan in the next town!
The purpose of the other party's coming here is very simple, to buy slaves!
They were already at the door, and it was obvious who the slave was.
As for why buying slaves is said to be acknowledging a foster father, it is because the founding emperor of Dashun stipulated that ordinary people were prohibited from raising private slaves. Therefore, many rich people adopted slaves in the form of adopting their daughters as sons. As long as they were certified by a notary, it was similar to that of later generations.
It stands to reason that since the original life was so difficult, selling oneself might be a way to survive. Being a housekeeper and providing food, it really gave me enough face.
But here’s the crux of the matter, who is so interested in recruiting slaves?
That Mr. Zhao is said to be a seductress!
When Liang Qu first arrived, he discovered that the boy he had traveled through time not only had the same name, but also had a similar appearance. He could be called his own version of himself in a parallel time and space. Even though his skin was a bit tanned as he had been fishing with his father for many years, he had excellent facial features and a good appearance. He was definitely not bad after raising him.
The combination of the two, the so-called "rumor"
, mostly true.
Thinking of this, Liang Qu shuddered and felt disgusted all over.
"How do you think about it?"
Zheng Xiang asked again.
The last time he visited, he was told to think about it, but now, he was fully confident that if the other party didn't accept his conditions, he might starve to death at home in the next few days!
Zheng Xiang even called people from the dental shop to come over as a guarantee, lest Liang Qu regret selling himself and go to the government to sue, saying that the Zhao family forced Liang Liang into slavery.
It's not that the Zhao family is afraid of being accused, who likes to cause trouble? How many pieces of paper do you need to wipe your butt?
The young man from the dental shop on the side also helped: "Yes, yes, young man, being able to go to the Zhao Mansion is a blessing that ordinary people like us can't get in a few lifetimes. Do you need to go through wind and rain like now and not be able to eat a few rations a year?"
"Your grandma, whoever wants to enjoy this blessing can enjoy it, and you don't have to worry about not being able to wipe your butt clean when you poop."
Liang Qu cursed secretly and declined politely. The Zhao family has a huge business and it is really not something he can offend now: "I'm really sorry, Butler Zheng. I'm so unlucky that I won't be able to enjoy such great blessings. I regret that your trip was in vain. Why don't you take this yellow croaker back as my apology?"
The Yaxing boy was stunned.
Zheng Xiang's expression changed. He didn't expect Liang Qu to refuse at all. He moved closer, forcing Liang Qu to take two steps back. However, the distance was still much closer, and he suddenly noticed something unusual.
Why does Liang Qu look so good? It doesn’t look like I’ve been hungry for a few days!
And where did this yellow croaker come from? Did he catch it?
Zheng Xiang's mind was spinning, and he couldn't understand why a helpless young man could change his mind in just a few days?
Liang QuHe was startled, and just when he was about to say something to save his own life, Zheng Xiang calmed down first: "Nothing, it's a deal that you and I agree on. There's no need to apologize. It's not easy to catch yellow croaker, so just keep it, little man. It's getting late, so I won't stay any longer. Say goodbye!"
While he was talking, Zheng Xiang had already left with the Yaxing boy, leaving only Liang Qu with the yellow croaker at the door.
